description: `typing.List`, `Dict`, `Optional` and friends: deprecated since 3.9, still working, no removal planned and no runtime warning.
`Any` disables checking like TypeScript's `any`; `object` accepts every value but allows only universal operations, like `unknown`.
A `.pyi` file with signatures only, used for untyped or compiled code; typeshed collects stubs for the standard library and popular packages.
Marker file (PEP 561) telling checkers that an installed package ships inline annotations.
Checker settings (`mypy --strict`, pyright `strict`) that require annotations everywhere and reject implicit `Any`.
